description.value: Requires: Legendary Power Feat, Super Saiyan God, and Full Power Super Saiyan. You have mixed Super Saiyan with Super Saiyan God but it's different than others, your hair elongates and your aura shines green with divine energy. You can use Super Saiyan God as a Power-Up with Full Power Super Saiyan.
